headers.name: actual_duplicate_cyclic_gaps
headers.header:
theorem actual_duplicate_cyclic_gaps
    (code : N.BlobPort b → Nat)
    (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf)
    (hnt : ∃ u v : BlobVertex N.graph b, u≠v) :
    ∃ (C : Set Plane) (f : ℝ → Plane) (θ : (M).OpenedTip → ℝ) (xs : List (M).OpenedTip),
      IsJordanCurve C ∧
      Graph.face (graph (blobCurves D b)) (curve (blobCurves D b))
        (coordinates face.outside)=outside C ∧
      IsLoop f ∧ f '' unitInterval=C ∧
      (∀ t, θ t∈Ico (0:ℝ) 1 ∧ f (θ t)=tipPoint N D b hg hb t) ∧
      Function.Injective θ ∧ xs.Nodup ∧ (∀ t, t∈xs) ∧
      xs.Pairwise (fun a c => θ a≤θ c) ∧
      (∀ (k : (M).OpenedHybridEdge) (a c d e : (M).OpenedTip),
        (OG).OrientedQuartet k ((M).openedTipVertex a) ((M).openedTipVertex c)
          ((M).openedTipVertex d) ((M).openedTipVertex e) →
        ¬((θ a<θ d ∧ θ d<θ c ∧ θ c<θ e) ∨
          (θ d<θ a ∧ θ a<θ e ∧ θ e<θ c))) ∧
      (∀ a c : (M).OpenedTip, θ a<θ c →
        (M).openedTipLabel hl a=(M).openedTipLabel hl c →
        (∀ w, ¬(θ a<θ w ∧ θ w<θ c)) ∨
          (∀ w, ¬(θ w<θ a ∨ θ c<θ w))) ∧
      (∀ a c : (M).OpenedTip, a≠c →
        (M).openedTipLabel hl a=(M).openedTipLabel hl c →
        Nanuq.Restriction.CyclicGap (xs.map (fun t => code ((M).openedTipLabel hl t)))
          (code ((M).openedTipLabel hl a)) (code ((M).openedTipLabel hl a)))

headers.name: rank_gap_cases
headers.header:
theorem rank_gap_cases {n : Nat} (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (hθ : StrictMono θ)
    (a c : Fin n) (hac : a<c)
    (hgap : (∀ w, ¬(θ a<θ w ∧ θ w<θ c)) ∨
      (∀ w, ¬(θ w<θ a ∨ θ c<θ w))) :
    c.val=a.val+1 ∨ (a.val=0 ∧ c.val+1=n)

headers.name: rank_cyclic_gap
headers.header:
theorem rank_cyclic_gap {n : Nat} (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (hθ : StrictMono θ)
    (a c : Fin n) (hac : a<c)
    (hgap : (∀ w, ¬(θ a<θ w ∧ θ w<θ c)) ∨
      (∀ w, ¬(θ w<θ a ∨ θ c<θ w))) :
    CyclicGap (List.range n) a.val c.val ∨ CyclicGap (List.range n) c.val a.val

headers.name: sorted_rank_strictMono
headers.header:
theorem sorted_rank_strictMono {T : Type*} (xs : List T) (θ : T → ℝ)
    (hnd : xs.Nodup) (hinj : Function.Injective θ)
    (hsort : xs.Pairwise (fun a c => θ a≤θ c)) :
    StrictMono (fun i : Fin xs.length => θ (xs.get i))

headers.name: sorted_empty_gap_cyclicGap
headers.header:
theorem sorted_empty_gap_cyclicGap {T : Type*} (xs : List T) (θ : T → ℝ)
    (label : T → Nat) (hnd : xs.Nodup) (hinj : Function.Injective θ)
    (hsort : xs.Pairwise (fun a c => θ a≤θ c))
    (a c : T) (ha : a∈xs) (hc : c∈xs) (hac : θ a<θ c)
    (hgap : (∀ w, ¬(θ a<θ w ∧ θ w<θ c)) ∨
      (∀ w, ¬(θ w<θ a ∨ θ c<θ w))) :
    CyclicGap (xs.map label) (label a) (label c) ∨
      CyclicGap (xs.map label) (label c) (label a)
